acceptance: Do not execute remotely until the owner explicitly approves this exact preflight and supplies the special password through an approved secure mechanism.
Read-only check trusted OS Python, Linux x86_64, cgroup v2, Landlock/seccomp availability, new fixed account/unit/path/port absence and safe ancestors.
Measure available memory, disk and inodes against the accepted controller criteria without claiming production capacity.
Verify existing MCP/Caddy/services remain untouched; emit only a sanitized report and never upload host config, credentials, database or private logs.
If preflight passes, stop and request separate approval for fresh install/bootstrap/loopback acceptance. Do not combine permission gates.
